cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

# Tests for esptk against the plugins in data/ (generated by data/make_fixtures.py).

# distribution packages (e.g. Fedora's GTest) only export a NOCONFIG configuration
set(CMAKE_MAP_IMPORTED_CONFIG_MINSIZEREL MinSizeRel RelWithDebInfo Release None NOCONFIG)
set(CMAKE_MAP_IMPORTED_CONFIG_RELWITHDEBINFO RelWithDebInfo Release MinSizeRel None NOCONFIG)
set(CMAKE_MAP_IMPORTED_CONFIG_RELEASE Release RelWithDebInfo MinSizeRel None NOCONFIG)

find_package(GTest REQUIRED)

add_executable(esptk_tests test_esp.cpp)
set_target_properties(esptk_tests PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 20 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
target_link_libraries(esptk_tests PRIVATE esptk GTest::gtest GTest::gtest_main)
target_compile_definitions(esptk_tests PRIVATE
	MO2_ESPTK_TEST_DATA="${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/data")

add_test(NAME esptk_tests COMMAND esptk_tests)
